text: I've been using dubbii for nearly 3 years now, aka right from the start. I still use it, still love it. Updates usually are gentle, helpful and quite easy to get used to. The dubbii Team obviously believes in what they do and are passionate about it. If something goes wrong (once in nearly 3 years) or a wish ist sent to them, they react within hours. Thanks dubbii family!
author: Hundehof Wauberg Alex Pazelt
developer_reply: Nearly 3 years with us?!Thank you so much for sticking with dubbii from the very beginning. It means the world to hear that the updates, support and little improvements have continued to feel helpful. We’re so lucky to have you in the dubbii family! Team dubbii.

text: Ich war ein großer Fan der App, die Videos und live sessions waren sehr motivierend und die App ist insgesamt sehr gut gemacht. Aber: Nach einer Pause wollte ich heute wieder starten und war sehr schockiert zu sehen, dass die App mittlerweile 14€/Monat kostet! Sorry, aber das ist echt zu viel! Ich bin sehr traurig, aber so kann ich die App nicht mehr nutzen.
author: Cee Jay
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback. We understand the price increase feels significant. The original price was set when dubbii mainly offered in-app videos. Since then, dubbii has grown hugely, with Lives, new features, a larger team and much more support behind the app. We really appreciate your past support. Team dubbii.

text: Love it so much, the step by step videos help me to form habits and the live sessions are lovely and comfortable, I'm always having fun with the dubclub. 🥰
author: Kayla
developer_reply: Thank you so much, Kayla! We’re so glad the step-by-step videos are helping you build habits and that you feel comfortable in the live sessions. It’s lovely to hear you’re having fun with the dubclub too! Team dubbii

text: super!
author: Maria
developer_reply: Thank you, Maria! We’re so glad you’re enjoying dubbii! Team dubbii.

text: I love it! Very easy to use and enjoyable.
author: Dilara Ismayilova
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your kind words! We're so happy to hear you're enjoying dubbii and finding it easy to use. We really appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback - it means a lot to the whole team! Team dubbii.

text: I am enamored with the app, so many of my problems seem more manageable now & for that I thank you very much. I do have a suggestion, I am not sure if this is the right place for it: I would wish for having the to do list button on the top instead of at the bottom, because I realized the more I have to scroll past tadas & todos my phone lags when I want to add new tasks, especially in session. And maybe a way to archive past achievents instead of just needing to delete them to fix performance?
author: D.C. I.
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your lovely feedback! We're so glad dubbii is helping make things feel more manageable. We love your suggestions about moving the To-Do button and archiving ta-das to help with performance. We'll pass both ideas on to the developers. Thanks for helping us make dubbii even better! Team dubbii

text: I used to love the app and the lives, but since a couple of weeks I cannot join them anymore on the new platform. I already wrote the support twice! I bought the year long subscription mainly for the lives and now it is useless. I love the community and the dubbii vibe and now I am sad and a bit upset for wasting my money and not being able to join anymore.
author: Mar Em
developer_reply: We're so sorry you've been having trouble accessing the lives. We have replied to support emails, so please check your junk/spam folder in case our responses have ended up there. If you still can't find them, please email us again and we'll do our best to get this sorted. Team dubbii.

text: Die Lives gibt es nur gegen Cash. 👎🏻 Ein paar Tage zum ausprobieren wären toll, ob es einen wirklich hilft, bevor man fast 10€ bezahlt.
author: Sarah Honigmann
developer_reply: Thank you for the feedback. We completely understand wanting more chance to try the live/body doubling side before committing to a subscription, especially when you’re not yet sure if it’ll work for you personally. Feedback like this genuinely helps us when discussing accessibility and trial options. Team dubbii.

text: I am amazed myself that this app did not turn out to be one of those "super-life-changing-for-three-days" apps. I actually use it consistently and it is helping me a lot. Can recommend for neurodivergent and neurotypical folks :)
author: Emilie Upmeier
developer_reply: That's honestly one of the best compliments we could get. So glad it stuck around past the "3-day miracle" phase and is actually helping long term - that's exactly what we hoped for. Thanks so much for recommending it too. Team dubbii.

text: Es scheint eine wirklich tolle App zu sein und ich liebe euch beiden einfach auch so ❤️ Aber ich finde es sehr schade, dass ich die Lives nicht wenigstens 1x testen kann, bevor ich ein Abo abschließe. Wegen der Lives habe ich mir die App heruntergeladen, aber ich weiß nicht sicher, ob die wirklich etwas für mich sind. Würde es die Möglichkeit geben, dass man Lives testen könnte, so wie man ja auch einen Task testen kann, dann würde ich auf jeden Fall 5 ⭐ geben! Die App ist mit viel Liebe gemacht
author: kristina siem
developer_reply: Thank you for the kind words - it means a lot. We understand wanting to try the Lives first, especially if that's what drew you in. We'll share this with the team as feedback, and we're always exploring ways to make it easier to know if it's a good fit before subscribing. Team dubbii.

text: the amount of stuff I got done, since I joined, is incredible
author: Kat Min
developer_reply: That's amazing to hear - we love celebrating wins like this! It's incredible what you can do with a little support and body doubling.We're so glad dubbii is helping you get things done, and we're really happy to have you as part of the community. Team dubbii.

text: I can't say much about the quality of the features itself, because it felt like I was being hit in the face by a paywall everywhere I clicked. And I'm not even told what exactly the subscription does for me. I can't find a summary to see whats free to use and what is not. theres no trial, at least I haven't found it. I dont know how many free videos I get etc. I am very understanding of payment models. Everyone needs to pay bills. This however, felt like a cashgrab.
author: 緒欄Akira
developer_reply: Thank you for sharing this – we’re really sorry it felt unclear and overwhelming. You’re absolutely right that we need to explain free vs paid features better, and we’ll work on clearer onboarding. You can also find details on how free tasks work on our website via the Support button in the app. Your feedback truly helps. Team dubbii.

text: The body doubling method has help me a lot. My space is clean and tidy. Very grateful that I found this app and the community ❤️🌹 But most of all that I don't feel so helpless anymore when facing my household chores. Update 02 of January 2026🍾 I still use dubbii and it is really a game changer for me with finally officially diagnosed ADHD. I established with this lovely community routines in my daily life and feel seen and understood in my journey to a life with ADHD.
author: Denise E
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that the body doubling method has made such a positive impact on your home and mindset. It’s wonderful to know that our app and community have helped you feel more in control. Keep up the great work! Team dubbii.

text: Die App war großartig! Seit dem letzten Update hängt sie im Startbildschirm fest. Nichts kann ich mehr einstellen, trotz De-und Reinstallieren! Und das, obwohl ich jetzt das teure Jahresabo habe!
author: Sarah Löhr
developer_reply:
Hello,

I'm so sorry that you have experienced these issues. Our tech team has found a pesky bug and they have now managed to squish it. If you look in the Play Store you should see an update that will fix it.

Kind Regards, Team dubbii.

text: Ich bin so dankbar für diese App. Insbesondere die Live Sessions haben mein Leben positiv verändert und das Abo mit 41€ für ein Jahr hat sich für mich schon nach der ersten Woche absolut gelohnt.
author: Cherish dubclub & 7 Cups
developer_reply:
Hello!

Thank you so much for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear the live sessions have made such a positive impact and that you found the subscription worthwhile so quickly.

Team dubbii.

text: Ich kann die App leider nicht besser bewerten, da sie bei mir nicht funktioniert. Ich habe sie inzwischen 3 mal neu installiert aber es funktioniert leider immer nur die Begrüßung. Auf dem darauf folgenden Startbildschirm kann ich nichts auswählen und scrollen, das ist einfach wie ein Bild. Schade. Keine Ahnung warum es auf meinem nicht funktioniert.
author: m k
developer_reply:
Hello,

I'm so sorry that you are having trouble with getting the app going. Please message us via the support button if you can, or email us hello@dubbii.app so that we can look in to it and get you on track.

Thanks and sorry again.
Team dubbii.

text: hey, i already love the app a lot it really helps me get stuff easily and fast done and i also tried a one month subscription for now to look if I need it. So why did I put 4 instead of 5 stars now?There is one issue I do have, but it's less an issue with the ap. It's more a adhd me thing. I somehow manage to something still ignore the nugets even if they have a special sound. So what to do about that?suggestion since my adhd brain is to stupid to set multiple reminders: Widgets listing nugets
author: Moon Light
developer_reply:
Hello!

Thanks for the thoughtful review! We're glad the app's helping you get things done. Great idea about a widget —we’ve noted it! You're not alone in missing reminders; we're always working on ways to make them more ADHD-friendly.

Thanks, Team dubbii.

text: Ich liebe es, ich war noch nie so produktiv und hatte eine so wunderschöne Wohnung. Es ist toll und die Lives sind genial und so positiv.
author: Belinda Schnetzer
developer_reply:
Hello!

Thank you so much! We’re thrilled to hear how much it’s helped you feel productive and positive — and we love that your space is reflecting that too!

Team dubbii.

text: Extremely helpful, it is changing my life right now. As a person with ADHD and autism, I need routines but cannot keep them, so aligning tasks and appointments with dubbii live sessions is a game changer. The dub club is also such a loving and supportive community, I feel so supported there!
author: Anna Lauenburger
developer_reply:
Hey!

Thank you so much for sharing this! We're thrilled to hear that dubbii is making a real difference in your life. Knowing it's helping you build routines and feel supported in the dubclub means the world to us.

Thank you, Team dubbii

text: Motivierende Videos, sehr hilfreich. Bedingung ist natürlich, dass man Englisch gut versteht.
author: Birgit Nietsch
developer_reply:
Hello,

Thank you so much for your kind words. So happy that you're finding dubbii helpful!

Team dubbii

text: Eine tolle App und sehr positive Community, die dahinter steht. Ich nutze vor allem die Lives, die mir sehr im Alltag helfen. Die App ist für mich, als jemand mit ADHS im Erwachsenenalter ein absoluter "Gamechanger". Man merkt, dass die sie von Menschen mit ADHS für Menschen mit ADHS gemacht wurde, weil sie unseren Bedürfnissen stark angepasst ist. Den Preis für das Abo finde ich angemessen und fair, man bekommt sehr viel dafür. Danke für diese Idee, gute und Umsetzung!
author: D. S.
developer_reply:
ChatGPT said:
Hello,

Thank you so much! We're thrilled dubbii and live streams are helping in your daily life. It means a lot to hear that the features are genuinely useful and thoughtfully aligned with what you need. Your kind words and support mean the world to our team!

Team dubbii.

text: Eine sehr tolle App mit viel Potenzial für weitere Ziele, die man im täglichen Leben zu haben kann. Ich habe die Bezahlversion und es ist jeden Cent wert. Vor allem, wegen der Community dahinter.
author: Andrea S.
developer_reply:
Hello!

Thank you for the great feedback! We're glad you're enjoying dubbii and the community. Your support means a lot, and we’re excited to keep improving and adding even more!

Team dubbii.

text: It works great! every time I loose the focus, I see you're still on it and that keeps me going. Problem is that the videos are waaaay to short. It would be better if I completed the task before you and could click to the next step instead of repeating the video again and again.:> maybe a messy mode for the small tasks too..?
author: Kira Streich
developer_reply:
Hello!
Thanks for the great feedback! We're glad it helps you stay focused. Longer videos is definitely something that we will think about in the future. Hope you continue to enjoy dubbii!
Team dubbii.

text: This is GENIUS. THANK U
author: Magdalena Kobaš
developer_reply: Hey, That's very kind, thank you. Happy you're enjoying! Team dubbii.

text: Literally one of the best apps if not the best app for adhers or people with executive dysfunction. The amount of things i cleaned willingly is shockingly high and the relief omg. Try it for yourself and let the magic work! The new live body doubling feature is just perfect!
author: kygm
developer_reply: Thank you so much for the amazing review! We're so glad to hear that dubbii is helping you with executive dysfunction and making cleaning more manageable. We’re thrilled you’re loving the new live body doubling feature! Your feedback means the world to us—thanks for being part of our community! Team dubbii.

text: For me, it's the best app! I've tried so many apps, but they haven't worked. This one has all the features I need. I can make my own "to-do list" and tick it off, and for difficult tasks, I use the videos, and they help so much. I'm finally managing to get a routine into my morning and evening! Racing against time against Rox when cleaning the kitchen motivates me every time! I am infinitely grateful, and so is my partner because thanks to the app, I manage to clean or make my bed more often.
author: Elisabeth -
developer_reply: We're thrilled to hear that our app has been so helpful in getting your routine on track and making your tasks more manageable. It's fantastic that the nudges and videos are supporting you, and racing Rox adds some fun motivation! We're so grateful for your support, keep up the great work! Team dubbii.

text: Positiv: Es ist perfekt für mich als ADS und meinem Mann mit Autismus Negativ: Wir können zwar Englisch, aber die Videos sind halt nicht für unsere Bekannten geeignet. Das mit dem Zahlen verstehe ich auch, aber trotzdem
author: Leonie One
developer_reply: Hello! I'm so happy that dubbii is helping you and your husband. Feedback is really important, so that we can keep on improving dubbii for our community, so thank you. Team dubbii.

text: I love it and I subscribed but since the last update I cannot access the videos anymore. After the task's introduction video there is no way to get further. This is more than suboptimal for the particular stage in which I click on the app in order to get help with a certain task I struggle with:( Update: it works again just fine so I will rate it better now. The app always helps me to get started. I would wish for much longer videos, as I almost never finish the tasks within the videos' time.
author: Mazita Zana
developer_reply:
Hey,

I'm so sorry that you are experiencing a glitch with the app. We have just pushed through a fix for this, so keep an eye out for an update. If you are still having problems then can you please contact us via the support button on the app (via the 3 dots in the top right corner) and we'll get it sorted.

So sorry again, Team dubbii.

text: It does so much to keep me from diving too deep into paralyse modus. I use "taking the bins out" for leaving the house. I need to bring it outside anyway but I stay more focused and leave more quickly than before with my small child (#bins producer).
author: Claudia Landgraf
developer_reply: Hello, Thank you so much for the amazing review! We're so happy to hear that dubbii helps you stay focused and tackle tasks like leaving the house with your little one. Your feedback means the world to us, and we're thrilled to be part of your routine! Keep up the great work! Team dubbii.

text: Great app! I enjoy it and you have a keen eye for the details :) And another thing: I got angry about that 1 star rating here from that woman which was like "Great idea, but this definitely should be free or atleast the majority should be free. [...] i'm not paying for this kind of stuff." What in the world?! Does this woman also work for free lol? Ratings like this should be forbidden as they say nothing about the app experience and are just insolent. Its much work to build an app like this.
author: S. -
developer_reply: Hi, Thank you so much for your review. So happy that you're enjoying dubbii! We will always try and make dubbii as accessible as we can to everyone, but unfortunately, as you say, it costs money to build an app like this. We will also always offer as much for free as we can. Thank you for your support. Team dubbii.

text: Obsessed Life changing!!
author: Melina
developer_reply: Thank you, So happy that dubbii is helping you.

text: I think the idea behind this app is great, unfortunately it is only in English and can't help me and my children (both kids have ADHD)
author: Jennifer Voll

We’re sorry it means dubbii can’t support you and your children right now. Expanding accessibility is important to us, and your feedback truly helps. Team dubbii.

text: Would love to rate better, but I subscribed, forgot about it and when ever I remembered, I tried it out but it always freezes after the intro videos. I have a Huawei p30 lite so not the newest.... Love you guys but have to unsubscribe. Sweet regards from Germany

text: The subscription comes with an "ADHD tax alert"! Theyll text you if you subscribed but stoped using it. So you don't pay for something you don't use. That's an awesome idea! Tho I think a trial week or day would be more beneficial than just one task.

text: I'm only on the free bit yet, so can't say much about the app in total. But I would love to give you some feedback already: please make it clearer in the first screen that you can only choose one of them for free, I was a bit confused that I first had so many and then only one left after I clicked on one. I totally understand that you can't make this app completely free, but I would appreciate a bit more transparancy in the app description and also on the insta account. Love what you're doing!

text: I tested the free task and it was amazing. Unfortunately there are not enough tasks that i struggle with but if it was, i would definitely buy it and recommend it.
